title: The Manifest
subtitle: Balochistan · Extraction, Disappearance & the Arithmetic That Will Not Close
abstract: GSS Anarchive · Collection 08. A counter-archive of Balochistan — 44% of Pakistan's landmass, holder of its gas, its copper, its deep-water port — built as a shipping manifest. What leaves (Sui gas piped to Punjab from 1952, Reko Diq copper and gold, Gwadar's CPEC concession), what arrives (internment centres, the 2025 Anti-Terrorism (Balochistan) Amendment Section 11-EEEE, anti-terrorism courts sitting inside Hudda Jail), and the one category that appears on no manifest at all: the disappeared. Voice for Baloch Missing Persons and Paank vs. Pakistan's own Commission of Inquiry on Enforced Disappearances — three counts of a number that will not close. Design conceit: the freight document; Baloch doch embroidery lattice at the threshold of visibility.
